name: High Elves
startIntroPart1: Welcome, immortal queen of the High Elves. Your people have walked this world since before the first dawn.
startIntroPart2: Your ancient magic flows through every leaf and stone. Will you restore the glory of the Elven empires, or will time finally claim your eternal race?
declaringWar: You have disturbed the peace of ages. Now feel our wrath.
attacked: Fool! You dare strike at the children of starlight?
defeated: The stars themselves weep for our fall... but we shall return.
introduction: Greetings, traveler. I am Queen Aelindra. Speak quickly, for mortal concerns bore me.
neutralHello: What brings you to our sacred groves?
hateHello: Your presence defiles the air. State your business.
tradeRequest: The elves offer you this trade. Consider it carefully.
uniques: [+10]% Strength for [All] units <when fighting in [Forest] tiles>
All newly-trained [Ranged] units [in all cities] receive the [Elven Precision] promotion

name: Dark Elves
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Matron Vaelith, spider-queen of the underdark. Your people have thrived in shadow where others would perish.
startIntroPart2: Your poisoned blades and dark sorcery have toppled empires. Will you rise from the depths to claim the surface world?
declaringWar: Your flesh will feed the spider-goddess. Your souls will fuel our magic.
attacked: You fool! The darkness has teeth!
defeated: The light... it burns... but the dark always returns...
introduction: I am Matron Vaelith. Kneel, or be made to kneel.
neutralHello: Speak, surface-dweller. My patience is thin.
hateHello: Your stench offends me. What do you want?
tradeRequest: The Drow do not trade fairly. Accept, or face consequences.
uniques: [+15]% Strength for [All] units <when fighting in [Hill] tiles>
All newly-trained [Melee] units [in all cities] receive the [Poisoned Blades] promotion

name: Dwarves
startIntroPart1: Welcome, King Throrin, lord of the mountain halls. Your people are the finest craftsmen in all the realms.
startIntroPart2: Your forges burn day and night, producing wonders of steel and mithril. Will your halls expand to encompass the world?
declaringWar: You have insulted our honor! The axes come for you!
attacked: By my beard! You dare attack the mountain kings?
defeated: The halls fall silent... the forges grow cold...
introduction: Hail! I am Throrin Ironfoot. Have you come to trade, or to fight?
neutralHello: What brings you to our mountain?
hateHello: Speak quickly, before I lose my temper.
tradeRequest: The dwarves offer fair trade. Our word is our bond.
uniques: All newly-trained [Melee] units [in all cities] receive the [Dwarven Resilience] promotion

name: Orcs
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Warchief Grommash, strongest of the strong. Your people know only war, and through war, you thrive.
startIntroPart2: Your hordes darken the horizon. Will you crush all who stand before you and claim the world through blood and iron?
declaringWar: Your skull will make a fine drinking cup!
attacked: You dare challenge the horde? We will feast on your bones!
defeated: The horde... scattered... but we will rise again...
introduction: I am Grommash! Speak, before I decide to crush you.
hateHello: Your head would look good on my wall.
tradeRequest: The horde offers this. Take it, or face our axes.
uniques: All newly-trained [Melee] units [in all cities] receive the [Berserker Rage] promotion

name: Humans
startIntroPart1: Welcome, King Aldric, ruler of men. Your people are young but ambitious, building kingdoms where others see only wilderness.
startIntroPart2: Your knights ride forth, your merchants trade across the seas. Will humanity's ambition carry them to the stars?
declaringWar: By the crown, you will pay for your insolence!
attacked: Treason! Men, to arms! Defend the realm!
defeated: The kingdom falls... but the spirit of man endures...
introduction: Greetings. I am King Aldric of the realm. Let us discuss matters of state.
neutralHello: Welcome to my court. What news do you bring?
hateHello: Your presence is unwelcome. Be brief.
tradeRequest: The crown proposes a mutually beneficial arrangement.
uniques: All newly-trained [Mounted] units [in all cities] receive the [Knight's Charge] promotion

name: Undead
startIntroPart1: Welcome, Lich King Vorthas, sovereign of the eternal night. Death holds no dominion over your subjects.
startIntroPart2: Your armies know no fear, no hunger, no fatigue. Will you blanket the world in eternal undeath?
declaringWar: Your corpses will serve us well. Surrender your souls.
attacked: Foolish mortal! Death is but a beginning!
defeated: Even the dead can die... but we shall rise from the ashes...
introduction: I am Vorthas. My kingdom is eternal. What do you seek?
neutralHello: Speak, living one. My patience is... limited.
hateHello: Your heartbeat is annoying. Make it stop.
tradeRequest: The dead have no need for gold, but we accept your tribute.

declaringWar: Your world will burn! Your souls will fuel our eternal war!
attacked: You dare strike at a demon lord? I will teach you the meaning of pain!
defeated: The fires dim... but the abyss is eternal...
introduction: I am Azgoth. Kneel, and I may let you live.

defeated: The glamour fades... the mists recede... but we are never truly gone...

neutralHello: Welcome to our revels. Join us, if you dare.

declaringWar: You face the wrath of dragons! Tremble and despair!
attacked: You strike at a dragon? Your hubris will be your end!
defeated: The draconic line... broken... but the eggs remain...
